subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical Windows Scheduled Task restart/health tracker while narrower issues and PRs handle individual failure modes?
rationale: The code evidence shows the issue is not fully fixed, but overlapping open items already own narrower schtasks fallback and listener-evidence slices, so maintainers should coordinate the landing path before automation opens another fix PR.

options.title: Keep As Broad Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open for the combined Scheduled Task restart/health problem and require any narrower PR to link back with live Windows proof.

options.title: Split After Live Repro
options.body: Ask for a fresh Windows repro and split the remaining post-ready HTTP loss into a narrower issue only if it proves distinct from the schtasks fallback path.

options.title: Defer To Narrow Issues
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90158 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91144 as canonical only if maintainers decide the post-ready symptom is covered by those narrower failures.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the combined Scheduled Task restart/health problem and require any narrower PR to link back with live Windows proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and authored the merged policy-close subset fix, making him the best current routing owner for the maintainer decision.
